proposed.text: What is the distinguishing factor between TGFA and AMVB under the Philippine development controls framework?

options.text: TGFA is measured in cubic meters; AMVB is measured in square meters, which reflects their different applications
TGFA = GFA + Non-GFA areas (sqm); AMVB = AMBF × BHL (cu.m) — they measure different quantities
TGFA and AMVB are the same quantity expressed in different units, leading to confusion in application
TGFA is for commercial buildings; AMVB applies only to residential buildings, ensuring compliance with specific zoning laws
